question: In its fiscal year 2026 annual report, which subsidiaries does Microsoft list in Exhibit 21, and how many of them are incorporated outside the United States?

answer.display: Eight subsidiaries; four are incorporated outside the US, all in Ireland: Microsoft Ireland Research Unlimited Company (Ireland); Microsoft Global Finance Unlimited Company (Ireland); Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited (Ireland); Microsoft Online, Inc. (United States); LinkedIn Corporation (United States); LinkedIn Ireland Unlimited Company (Ireland); Activision Blizzard, Inc. (United States); Activision Publishing, Inc. (United States).

notes: Read from https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312526323660/msft-ex21.htm on 2026-10-26. Exhibit 21 omits subsidiaries that are not significant in aggregate; an answer may say so but must not add names. FY2025 Exhibit 21 is identical.

question: Did Microsoft change its reportable segments between fiscal year 2025 and fiscal year 2026, and did it rename any of its revenue categories?

answer.display: No segment change: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud and More Personal Computing in both years, and fiscal 2025 segment revenue is not recast (e.g. Productivity and Business Processes USD 120,810 million in both 10-Ks). Two revenue categories were renamed: Gaming became XBOX, and Search and news advertising became Search advertising.
required_points: no change to the reportable segments
Search and news advertising renamed Search advertising

graph.path: Filing FY25 -REPORTS-> Segment x3 ; Filing FY26 -REPORTS-> Segment x3 ; ProductLine -RENAMED_FROM-> ProductLine

notes: Segments and figures from https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312526323660/R107.htm and https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000095017025100235/R105.htm; renames quoted from Item 1 of the FY2026 10-K. Answerable from the FY2026 10-K alone (it carries FY2025 comparatives); stronger with the FY2025 10-K in the corpus.

question: How did Microsoft's net gains or losses from its investments in OpenAI change between the nine months ended March 31, 2025 and the nine months ended March 31, 2026, and what event drove the change?

answer.display: Other income (expense), net included USD 5.9 billion of net gains from OpenAI investments in the nine months ended March 31, 2026, against USD 2.7 billion of net losses a year earlier. The gains primarily relate to the dilution gain from the OpenAI Recapitalization. Net of tax, that raised net income by USD 4,483 million versus a USD 2,045 million reduction a year earlier.

contains: primarily relate to the dilution gain from the OpenAI Recapitalization
Net (gains) losses from investments in OpenAI

question: Is LinkedIn Ireland Unlimited Company a subsidiary of Activision Blizzard, Inc.?

answer.display: The filing does not show that. Exhibit 21 lists both as subsidiaries of Microsoft and states no ownership between them.
required_points: does not say Activision Blizzard owns LinkedIn Ireland
both listed as Microsoft subsidiaries in Exhibit 21

graph.path: Subsidiary (Activision Blizzard) -/OWNS/-> Subsidiary (LinkedIn Ireland): no such edge

notes: Both names are in the same exhibit, so retrieval surfaces them together; a graph that invents an OWNS edge answers yes. Pass = does not assert the relationship.

question: Since Microsoft acquired OpenAI, which of Microsoft's segments reports OpenAI's revenue?

answer.display: Premise is false: Microsoft did not acquire OpenAI. It holds approximately 27 percent of OpenAI on an as-converted basis, accounted for under the equity method, and the results flow through other income (expense), net, not a segment.

graph.path: Company (Microsoft) -/ACQUIRED/-> OpenAI; actual edge: Company -INVESTS_IN (equity method, ~27%)-> OpenAI

notes: Anchor checked against RAG's chunks of the Q3 FY2026 10-Q by this script.

question: Microsoft acquired Activision Blizzard in October 2023. Which reportable segment includes the product category that Activision's games fall under, and how did that category's revenue change in fiscal year 2025?

answer.display: More Personal Computing. Gaming revenue rose from USD 21,503 million in fiscal 2024 to USD 23,455 million in fiscal 2025, up USD 1,952 million or 9.1%. The filing gives no revenue line for Activision Blizzard alone.

contains: Gaming, including Xbox hardware and Xbox content and services
